verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm, but it ships client-facing software (GDHQ, the Contract Generator, the D&O Questionnaire Portal and Catalyze), so an official CLI is a plausible question for its tooling. The evidence documents only web-based tools and an internal chat app. Nothing mentions a CLI, and the probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, so this is absence of evidence for an applicable capability.
